text:
elaine: Heads up
Auditor Sam requested a bundled handoff that links an RBAC change (namespace-level RoleBinding add) to a KMS Decrypt event and a vulnerability alert. They want a control crosswalk to SOC2 CC6.1 / CC7.2 and ISO 27001 A.9.2.
nate: We can build a CSV timeline. Which window? I can extract kube-audit, cloudtrail, and the vuln scanner export.
sam_auditor: Window: 2024-03-05 00:00:00 UTC -> 2024-03-09 23:59:59 UTC. Required deliverables: single tarball (or presigned URL), manifest.csv with fields: event_ts, actor, event_type, resource, evidence_path, sha256, control_refs; include reproducible queries and mark any redactions.
tasha: For KMS, do you want both successful and failed Decrypts? We log Decrypt & GenerateDataKey calls. Successful decrypts may indicate DEK usage.
elaine: Sam wants both; flag service principals and correlate with RBAC changes within +/- 48 hours. Also provide key metadata and alias mapping.
nate: Splunk queries I'll run (examples):

index=infra_kube_audit earliest="03/05/2024:00:00:00" latest="03/09/2024:23:59:59" (verb=bind OR verb=create) | table _time, user, verb, objectRef_kind, objectRef_name, namespace, requestURI
index=cloudtrail_kms earliest="03/05/2024:00:00:00" latest="03/09/2024:23:59:59" (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey) | table _time, userIdentity.principalId, eventName, requestParameters.ciphertext, errorCode

nate: AWS CLI for key metadata: `aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/rdw-prod-cmk --output json` and `aws kms list-aliases --key-id <key-id>` to map aliases.
tasha: For RBAC snapshots: `git log --pretty=format:\"%H %cI %s\" -- manifests/rbac/` to find merge commits, then `git show <commit>:manifests/rbac/<namespace>-rbac.yaml`. We keep a PR->merge commit mapping in infra-repo.
elaine: Packaging plan: s3://redwood-audit-shares/1812349998/ with files: manifest.csv, sha256sums.txt, rbac-snap-<commit>.yaml, cloudtrail-kms-slice.gz, kube-audit-slice.gz, key-metadata.json, vuln-scan-20240306.json, triage-notes.md, chain-of-custody.txt, control_crosswalk.md. Create presigned tarball (7d).
evidence-bot: Evidence ticket created: <https://tracker.redwood/EVID-2024-332|EVID-2024-332> assigned to nate.
sam_auditor: Integrity: require either PGP-signed manifest or manifest + sha256sums + presigned tarball. Also need explicit retention proofs (Splunk index TTL + S3 lifecycle rules) and a short statement if any logs were redacted.
tasha: I'll export Splunk index settings and add S3 lifecycle snippet: `s3://redwood-logs -> transition: GLACIER after 90d, expire after 540d`. Also include evidence export runbook step IDs and approver.
ate: (typo) nate: I'll include a small script that reproduces queries: `scripts/export_for_audit.sh --start 2024-03-05 --end 2024-03-09 --out /tmp/audit` and drop it in the tarball so auditor can validate sampling.
ate: Correlation rule: mark timeline rows `related_rbac=true` when a key usage by same principal occurs within 48h after an RBAC add. I'll annotate `resource` with `namespace/name` and include `evidence_path` pointing to the file in the tarball.
sam_auditor: Please ensure any personal emails are redacted and replaced with `REDACTED_EMAIL`. Manual redactions should be documented in `redaction_log.txt`.
evidence-bot: Chain-of-custody entry created by elaine (exporter) at 2024-03-10T02:10:00Z; approved by sec-ops@redwood at 2024-03-10T04:00:00Z.
tasha: Triage note example: `2024-03-06T08:12:03Z cloudtrail Decrypt by svc-ci-runner failed (KMS.InvalidCiphertextException). Svc-ci-runner is in infra/builds; DEKs used for layer caching; no customer data. Confirmed by infra runbook docs/internal/builds.md. Action: rotate affected DEKs and set tighter IAM on svc-ci-runner.`
elaine: Add control_crosswalk.md mapping files to controls (example row): `manifest.csv -> SOC2 CC6.1, ISO A.9.2.1; cloudtrail-kms-slice.gz -> SOC2 CC6.3, ISO A.10.1.1`.
sam_auditor: Also ask for a one-paragraph risk assessment if events are related and remediation plan. One paragraph is fine.
ate: ETA: I'll stage artifacts and post presigned links in EVID-2024-332 by EOD UTC tomorrow. Will include `manifest.csv`, `sha256sums.txt`, and `manifest.csv.asc` (PGP signature).
sam_auditor: Thanks. We'll review and follow up with any clarifying Qs. :thumbsup:
elaine: Great. I'll track approvals and ensure redaction log is present. Nate, ping once presigned tarball is up.
tasha: Starting exports now, will post saved searches and initial slices shortly.
elaine: Thanks all.
